data.question: Count distinct destination IPs receiving TCP flows after 2011-08-15 17:00:00 in CTU scenario 5 and after 2011-08-16 14:00:00 in scenario 7; use strict time boundaries.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS distinct_dst_ips
FROM network_flows f
WHERE f.dst_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM network_flows s5
    WHERE s5.dst_ip = f.dst_ip
      AND s5.source_dataset = 'ctu13_s5'
      AND s5.protocol = 'TCP'
      AND s5.event_time > TIMESTAMP '2011-08-15 17:00:00'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM network_flows s7
    WHERE s7.dst_ip = f.dst_ip
      AND s7.source_dataset = 'ctu13_s7'
      AND s7.protocol = 'TCP'
      AND s7.event_time > TIMESTAMP '2011-08-16 14:00:00'
  );

hypotheses.description: The distinct destination IPs receiving TCP flows after the given time boundaries in both CTU scenarios 5 and 7 represent active communication endpoints potentially relevant for network monitoring or threat analysis.

limitations: The data only reflects the CTU dataset scenarios 5 and 7 and the specified time boundaries; it may not represent other scenarios or time periods.
The analysis does not include context on the nature of the TCP flows or whether these IPs are benign or malicious.
CTI (Cyber Threat Intelligence) and endpoint context or semantic correctness of the data are not verified.
final_assessment: There are 459 distinct destination IPs that received TCP flows after the specified strict time boundaries in CTU scenario 5 (after 2011-08-15 17:00:00) and scenario 7 (after 2011-08-16 14:00:00).
